system.description: Dragonkin are peoples descended from dragons, created in their image, or fundamentally shaped by draconic power. Although they may possess reptilian or serpentine features, their supernatural lineage distinguishes them from ordinary Beastfolk. Define a Draconic Lineage with the GM that fits the Campaign, identifying the specific power or environmental affinity expressed by your lineage.

nature.name: Draconic Core
nature.text: Ordinary environmental exposure associated with your Draconic Lineage does not harm you. You may also project a brief harmless manifestation of your Lineage up to 1 unit away, allowing you to ignite or extinguish tinder, chill or warm a small object, scatter loose material, produce light, create a sharp sound, or cause another comparable environmental effect. Choose one Dragonkin Species Trait.

traits.name: Burrowing Claws
traits.text: Gain Burrow 5 through loose earth, sand, snow, or similarly workable material.

traits.name: Draconic Armament
traits.text: Choose claws, horns, fangs, or a tail as a natural weapon. It otherwise counts as a basic one-handed weapon, does not consume Armory or Inventory capacity, and cannot be disarmed, but it uses the chosen anatomy rather than automatically requiring a free hand. Claws normally require the relevant hand or limb; horns or fangs require the head or mouth; a tail requires the tail. The required body part must be available when you attack with it. Its default Range is 1. When choosing the Trait, choose Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing Damage appropriate to its anatomy with the GM. It uses Basic Melee Attack’s normal Damage and Surge option and grants no additional equipment properties or Mounts unless another rule provides them.

traits.name: Hoard Sense
traits.text: After handling an object for one minute, you may claim it as part of your hoard. While it remains within the same region, you know its general direction and whether it is moving. You may have only one claimed object at a time. You can also identify an examined object's primary material, general quality, and whether it is an obvious imitation.

traits.name: Lineage Scales
traits.text: The first time each Encounter you take Damage from a source directly associated with your Draconic Lineage, reduce that Damage by 1. This protection does not prevent Breach.

traits.name: Tail Balance
traits.text: Ignore the first unit of Difficult Terrain you cross each turn and reduce involuntary movement against you by 1 unit.

traits.name: True Breath
traits.text: Gain the True Breath Species Combat Card under Species Combat Cards later in this chapter. Once per Encounter, it releases your Draconic Lineage in a 2-unit cone to change terrain, clear loose material, or create visual obstruction. It does not directly cause Damage.

traits.name: Wings
traits.text: You may glide using the Gliding procedure in Combat Encounters: Movement, including normal use of Dash. This Trait does not allow you to gain height or hover.
